step1Title: Let’s make this feel like yours
step1Desc: A little context helps Dossierly start in the right place.
step2Title: Where are you in your journey?
step2Desc: There’s no perfect answer. Choose what feels closest today.
step3Desc: Choose the help you need. We’ll start with what matters most.
step4Title: From the original to your next step
step4Desc: Explore every kind of help you chose, starting with your main priority.
step5Desc: One mail provider. One calendar. Both optional, and both still a setup preview.
gmailPurpose: Review relevant office messages and attachments.
gmailPermission: A future setup would use Google sign-in and ask you to approve email access. Message selection and exact permissions would be reviewed before connecting.
gmailBoundary: This preview cannot read or send email.
outlookPurpose: Bring relevant messages and attachments into view.
outlookPermission: A future setup would use Microsoft sign-in and show the requested email permissions for review. Selecting Outlook replaces a previous mail choice in this preview.
outlookBoundary: This preview cannot access your Microsoft account or email.
gcalPurpose: Keep reviewed dates alongside your plans.
gcalPermission: A future setup would use Google sign-in and request calendar permissions. You would review which calendar to use and each proposed event.
gcalBoundary: This preview cannot read calendars or create events.
mscalPurpose: Plan around dates in your Microsoft / Outlook calendar.
mscalPermission: A future setup would use Microsoft sign-in and show the requested calendar permissions. You would review each suggested event before adding it.
mscalBoundary: This preview cannot access calendars or create events.
applecalPurpose: Explore keeping reviewed dates in Apple Calendar.
applecalPermission: Apple Calendar would use an “Add to Apple Calendar” calendar-file handoff: review the date, then choose whether to add it in Calendar yourself. This preview does not offer Apple sign-in, live iCloud access or two-way sync.
applecalBoundary: No Apple account, password or secret is requested. This preview cannot read calendars or create events.
lettersReqExpl: The fictional letter asks for a copy of the health insurance confirmation. Check the complete original and the office’s instructions before choosing which document to provide.
lettersDetExpl: 18 November 2026 is a fictional date written into this example. It is not a general legal deadline. In a real case, use the terms in the letter you actually received.
documentsReqExpl: This checklist separates an uncertain item from documents already prepared. Confirm the accepted insurance evidence against the office’s current instructions.
documentsDetExpl: The source explicitly says the document type is unconfirmed. The next step is to clarify it, not to treat this sample list as an official requirement.
deadlinesReqExpl: This is an information appointment in the sample. It does not establish a filing deadline or confirm that an application has been approved.
deadlinesDetExpl: The sample appointment is 18 November 2026 at 10:30. Review the date and location before choosing a reminder; this preview cannot create calendar events.
appointmentsReqExpl: The goal is to clarify what is missing and how to provide it. A short question list helps keep the conversation focused without assuming the answer.
appointmentsDetExpl: This is a fictional visit time for the walkthrough. It does not book an appointment or establish which office handles your real case.
communicateReqExpl: “Could you confirm that you have received my documents?” This asks for receipt confirmation; it does not presume approval.
communicateDetExpl: The follow-up asks whether anything else is needed. Review the wording and add your real reference only when preparing an actual message yourself.
updatesReqExpl: “Documents received” confirms receipt in this sample. It does not say that a decision has been made.
updatesDetExpl: The sample records an update on 2 November 2026 and explicitly has no decision information. Keep confirmed facts separate from unknowns.

choicesStay: Your choices stay in this tab.

note2: Your context, without asking for sensitive documents.

stageLabel: Where are you in the process?
cityHelp: Still deciding? You can leave this blank.
officePlaceholder: Office name, if you know it
helpHint: Choose as many as you need.
mainHelp: Your first choice starts as the main priority. You can change it here.
needsEmpty: Choose at least one kind of help to shape your example.
exampleEach: · every selected priority has its own example
startAnywhere: Start anywhere. Your edits stay with each example.
meetArjun: Meet Arjun. This fictional document gives you something concrete to explore.
introHelp: Read the original on the left, select a marked passage, or ask for the explanation below. Nothing is analysed or sent to a service.
draftHelp: Edit before review. This draft stays in the preview.
reviewedHelp: Only this sample is confirmed. No document, message, reminder or account was changed.
reviewHelp: Review the wording before confirming this sample action.
toolsNote: Connection previews only. Choose up to one mail provider and one calendar. No service connects or accesses your data.
docsNote: Documents can come from in-app uploads or mail attachments in the planned product. No file access is requested here.
startSummary: Help priorities brought together: {n}. Samples reviewed: {reviewed}.
planHelp: A suggested path through Dossierly, not an official process checklist. Each next step below is still a sample.
finishNote: You’re still in the preview. No account, case or connection has been created. Refreshing starts again.
selectPassage: Select a highlighted passage to explore it.
layoutNote: Layout informed by a {link}; all case details are fictional.
errQuestion: Add a question to review first.
chatIntro: Explore how a conversation could work. Questions stay in this tab; no answer is generated. Dossierly offers guidance, not application completion or submission.
welcomeTitle: A question, with the right context
welcomeBody: Write a question or paste one you already have. You’ll review the text and any sample source before adding it here.
responseHelp: This is a fixed example of the response format, not a generated answer to your question.
noSourceResponse: A helpful response would first clarify your question and identify a relevant source. No source was attached to this preview message, so no case-specific guidance is shown.
youDecide: You decide what to do next. No document is completed and no application is submitted.
questionAdded: Question added to the preview. It hasn’t been sent to a service.
reviewNote: Only the text above and this sample context will appear in the preview. Links are treated as text and never opened or imported.
pasteChoose: Paste text you choose to share
pasteHelp: Paste the question itself from your notes or another conversation. This does not import private chats or read shared links. Review the text before adding it.
askPlaceholder: What would you like help understanding?
composerHelp: Text and sample attachments only. No uploads, private-chat imports or live advice in this preview.
